bundle.shortDescription: See what your AI coding assistants actually cost.
bundle.longDescription: FreeTokenMeter reads the usage history that OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Freebuff and Gemini CLI already keep on this machine, and shows tokens, a reference API value in USD, and what (if anything) you actually paid. Everything stays local.
